{{Otheruses|Darklighter}}
A '''Darklighter spin''' was a maneuver improvised by [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] shortly after he joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. By spinning his [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] while firing all four of its [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], he was able to eliminate multiple incoming targets at once.<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Darklighter Spin}}</ref>
